description: Find anything on the Texas grid by name when you do not have coordinates: substations (by name, owner company, city or ERCOT substation code), planned grid projects (by name, owner, utility or PUCT/ERCOT docket), battery storage projects (by name, developer, point of interconnection or ERCOT INR number), TCEQ air permits (by company, project or permit number), generation queue projects, ERCOT pricing nodes, and Texas cities and counties. Returns each match with its type, a short description, what field matched, and coordinates to pass to other tools. Use for questions like 'where is the Hillje substation', 'what does Formosa Plastics own', 'find 21INR0258', or 'which projects are under docket 25RPG025'.

kinds.description: Limit to these result types. Default all.

query.description: Name, company, code, INR, permit number, docket, city or county.

name: search_grid
title: Search the Texas grid by name
